desc: Derive the per-number reduction count and its geometric interval boundaries.
Design and implement the prefix-sum function \(F(n)=\sum_{x=1}^{n}\text{reductions}(x)\) in \(O(\log_4 n)\).
Prove the pairing bound for every contiguous query interval, including the maximum-single-element workload constraint.
Implement `minOperations` for up to \(10^5\) queries with safe integer arithmetic.
Run the implementation against both examples and boundary cases near powers of four.
